sentences: We do not tolerate the use of VPNs under any circumstances.
It is imperative that you never use a VPN when working remotely.
You'll be handling sensitive company information, so it's crucial that you adhere to our security protocols at all times.
Always use secure connections, encrypt sensitive data, and report any suspicious activity immediately.
